note: Single tuning file for the building resize pilot. Each building in `families` takes a named stretch range from `stretch.bands`, and may name a facade kit for free draw. `families` is generated: edit `rollout`, then run `python scripts/building_resize_trial.py --sync-families`. After any other edit run it with `--write-mirror` so backend/app/data/buildingResizeTrial.json stays byte-identical. Nothing here publishes a catalogue entry or grants keeper approval.

wide.use: The two buildings piloted and rendered at these limits. Windows are visibly narrow at 70% and wide at 140%.

regular.use: Buildings made of repeating bays: apartments, mixed use, low offices, shops, industry, townhouse rows.

careful.use: Houses, one-off civic buildings, stations, parkades and anything nine storeys or taller. A change this small is hard to see.

aspen_terrace.source: Dimensions and colours measured from final-seniors-apartments-clay-v003.glb. Glass and frame are darker than the model's, because massing glass is opaque and has no room behind it. Bays repeat on these modules and never stretch.

brick_garden_courtyard.source: Dimensions and colours measured from final-courtyard-block-clay-v006.glb. The model's wings are 4.4 m deep front and rear and 6.3 m at the sides; the kit uses one depth between them. Glass is darker than the model's, because massing glass is opaque. Bays repeat on these modules and never stretch.

rollout.note: Rules for `python scripts/building_resize_trial.py --sync-families`, which rebuilds `families` from seed/model-library/rlasm-architectural-clay/library.json. A building takes its range from `band_overrides`, else `tall_band` when it has `tall_from_storeys` storeys or more, else `band_by_group` for its picker group.
